sections.text_helper: Section 25.7 "CCB registers" in chapter 25 (Coupling and chaining bridge (CCB)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 768.
sections.section_content:
The following section provides information on registers.
Reserved bits (marked as Res.) must be kept at their reset values, unless otherwise
specified.
For general information relative to register description, refer to Document conventions.
These registers are accessible through the AHB interface of the CCB (32-bit words only). All
reads are supported. Writes accesses must be 32-bit word only (other access types
generate an AHB error).
